Name: Speed Rooster For Coop
Author: Dionaeam
Description:
I wanted to add the purple rooster of the [url=http://https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Desert_Festival]Desert Festival[/url]﻿ race to put on my Coop and match my Blue Chicken. So what I did was to add it with the same rules as the Blue Chicken, but laying brown eggs (because Blue Chicken already layed white eggs). To be more specific: you need to unlock the [url=http://https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Shane]8 hearts event with Shane[/url]﻿ where he introduces you to "Charlie". After that, the same chance you have to buy the [url=http://https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Chicken#Blue_Chickens]Blue Chicken[/url]﻿ at marnie's will be the chance to also receive a Speed Rooster. This mod does NOT replace the Blue Chicken as a Speed Rooster, so you'll have the chance to buy four different chickens after unlocking Shane's 8 hearts event.

The PT-BR translated version is already included in the main file.


~Future Projects: To add purple eggs an purple mayonnaise to the speed rooster. 
                               To add blue eggs an blue mayonnaise to the blue chicken.
                               Make both of them hatchable by respective eggs.

                              Include other Desert Racers with different mechanics in-game.
